correctness.rationale: The open-access Hussain–Alharthi seven-coordinate system (4) has exactly three independent Wiener drivers. Its diffusion columns have zero entries at coordinates 5 and 6; A=GG^T annihilates both e5 and e6, with rank at most three everywhere. Hence no positive M1 makes zeta^T A zeta>=M1||zeta||^2 on a nonempty open set for every zeta, contrary to the uniform ellipticity assumption cited in Lemma 3.3 and Remark 3.4. Independently, the displayed Lyapunov V(40)-(42) has no x5 term, so it is zero all along the x5-ray through the purported equilibrium, not positive definite or coercive. The purported bounded ellipsoid in (50) omits x3 and x5, admitting unbounded positive rays. These are separate algebraic contradictions within the published proof and require no probabilistic simulation. They invalidate the stated proof route ONLY; degenerate SDEs can still be ergodic through unproved alternative arguments.
